name: 97089 · Damascus, OR
findings: ZIP 97089 (Damascus) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97089 (Damascus) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 97089 (Damascus) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
